emma: Heads-up - GovCorp wants a sealed-environment POC. Requirements: USB-only bundle delivery, offline activation (no outbound calls), weekly maintenance window only, and proofs that no telemetry is sent. Any blocking items?

diego: We can supply a signed monolithic bundle for initial install + signed weekly deltas. For proving no telemetry, we offer a signed usage manifest tool that runs locally and emits a signed report the customer can keep.

rachel: Runtime caveat: the optimized runtime depends on a specific kernel module (red_rt v3) and a matching driver. We'll need exact host kernel version list from GovCorp. Also if they insist on embedded HSM for signing, we support verifying customer-signed activations via provided public keys.

tom (security): SOW/security needs: chain-of-custody for physical media, statement of no-telemetry (how it's enforced), indemnity carveouts if customer modifies host drivers, and requirement for SBOM and detached signatures on all artifacts. Also ensure FIPS mode compatibility if requested.

build-bot: artifact ready: govcorp-poc-202403.tar.gz sha256=8f3d2a1b4c5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1 (signed)

emma: Good. Action items: Diego prep BOM + one-page install/runbook by Fri; Rachel produce kernel compatibility matrix by Wed; Tom draft SOW points and no-telemetry attest template. I'll schedule customer sync Mon 9am PT.

diego: Also adding note: if GovCorp rejects any executables outside the bundle, we can deliver patches as signed container images and provide a loader script in the bundle.

emma: Perfect, thanks team. I'll follow up after the Mon sync. :thumbsup:
